children: Aerodrome Finance has activated incentives for top pools across Ethereum. AERO holders can now stake their tokens to earn rewards through the Ethereum pool incentives.

The launch extends AERO's staking utility beyond Base and brings its token emissions to a new market. Holders can use AERO to earn staking rewards on Ethereum, though the immediate incentive amounts shown are small.
Incentives are live for top pools across Ethereum.
Stake AERO and start earning today 🛫

title: Aerodrome Finance: Ethereum pool incentives go live - 24 Oct 2026
